description.to:
Outcome: Add an output prefix to the projection's writers (empty by default, so dedicated sites write exactly where they do today); every key the writers produce (pages, listings, _data, twins, sitemap, robots, 404) goes under it; a writer refuses a key outside its prefix when a prefix is set. Renditions are part 2. Size: one agent session. Worktree Papyrus-worktrees/ (beside the Papyrus checkout) projection-output-prefix, branch feature/<this issue id>-projection-output-prefix from origin/develop (spikes: branch spike/<this issue id>-projection-output-prefix, sandbox only, no PR needed beyond notes).

Touches (verified at origin/develop 23fabe1d): src/papyrus_content/projection/writers.py, runtime.py, deploy_render.py, projector.py, and their tests.

Acceptance (Gherkin feature file: features_backend/tenant-output-prefix.feature):
Scenario: A dedicated site's keys do not change
    Given a site with no output prefix
    When it is projected
    Then the key listing is byte-identical to before

Scenario: A prefixed projection writes only under its prefix
    Given output prefix "sites/alpha/"
    When the site is projected
    Then every key starts with "sites/alpha/"

Dependencies: blocked by nothing. Blocks nothing in this plan yet. (Also recorded as kbs dependencies.)
Implements or extends: -.

Testing: poetry run pytest src/papyrus_content/projection; npm run test:bdd:backend -- features_backend/tenant-output-prefix.feature (via poetry run behave).
Rollout: Merge to develop by PR when green (not a release; the newsroom automation session owns releases). Record branch, PR and verification on this issue.
Risk and mitigation: Low; scoped to one session.

Releasable on its own: yes.
DynamoDB index: none.
AppSync authorisation: unchanged.
Design note: docs/plans/multi-tenant-architecture.md (PR on branch docs/multi-tenant-architecture).
